svg.title: FinPilot architecture
svg.desc: FinPilot: multi-agent personal-finance co-pilot. Interfaces, FastAPI, LangGraph agents with guardrails, Celery workers, PostgreSQL and Redis, Mesh API, FX MCP server and Langfuse.
svg.text: From a plain-language question to a verified answer: numbers come from code, language models only classify, parse, choose and phrase.
Chat runs a tool loop over your own
LLM; unsure ones go to a review queue.
Monte Carlo cash bands; “can I afford
edit, pin or delete every item.
Number checks, PII masking, chat scope
Numbers that can’t be verified are never shown: the guard retries once, then falls back to a deterministic template.
LLMs classify, parse, choose and phrase.
Every figure passes the grounding guard.
